data.one_liner: Extended text field to quickly build inline images, @mentions, custom backgrounds and selection tools.
data.what_it_does: Extends Flutter's official TextField component to support inline images, special text spans like @somebody with custom backgrounds, and custom selection controls or toolbars.
use_when: You need to display inline images inside a text field alongside regular text.
You need custom formatting for specific patterns like @mentions or hashtags.
You want to build custom text selection toolbars and handles.
avoid_when: You are using RTL text direction (not supported for special text).
You need to use obscureText for passwords or sensitive input (not supported with special text).
strengths: Supports inline images and mixed text seamlessly.
Enables copying the actual text value while rendering special spans.
Allows full customization of selection handles and context menus.
weaknesses: Does not support special text when TextDirection.rtl is active.
Does not handle special text when obscureText is true.
